language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the interface, notifications and AI mentor. Content written by the team stays in its author's language.
account.title: Settings
account.createOrJoin: Create a startup or join a team through Discover
account.atLimit: That's the maximum per account. To join somewhere else, leave one team first.
account.delete.title: Delete account
account.delete.body: Deletes your profile, conversations and memberships. Before deleting, we'll show you what happens to your teams.
credentials.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
credentials.emailSentBody: We sent a link to {email}. The address changes once you click it.
credentials.emailDescription: A link will be sent to the new address. Until you click it, you sign in with the old one.
credentials.passwordTooShort: The password must have at least {count} characters.
credentials.reauthenticate: For security reasons, sign in again and try once more.
credentials.passwordChangedBody: Use the new one next time you sign in.
delete.title: Delete your account forever?
delete.description: This can't be undone. There's no trash and no cooling-off period.
delete.goesProfile: Your public profile, photo and skills.
delete.goesConversations: All conversations, contact requests and invitations.
delete.goesMemberships: {count, plural, one {Membership in one team.} other {Membership in # teams.}}
delete.soleFounder: {count, plural, one {The startup where you're the only Founder} other {The startups where you're the only Founder}}
delete.soleFounderList: {names} — together with all of the team's work.
delete.handOver: If this project should live on, first hand over the Founder role to someone in the team. Then the startup stays and you just leave it.
delete.handOverLink: Hand over the Founder role in the Team tab
delete.typeEmail: Type your email address to confirm
delete.noEmail: The account has no email address — delete it in the Supabase dashboard.
delete.mismatchServer: The address you typed doesn't match this account's address.
delete.permissionDenied: The database doesn't allow deleting the account from the app. It has to be deleted in the dashboard: Supabase → Authentication → Users.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: This is what people see when they come across you in the Social layer.
profile.completenessHint: An incomplete profile shows up in results less often
profile.photoWhy: In Discover, the photo decides about a click more than anything else in your profile.
profile.photoFormats: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB.
profile.fullNameHint: This is how you sign within the team: in the member list, goals and tasks.
profile.publicNameHint: Optional. This is how people outside the team see you: on your card, in contact requests and conversations. Empty = your full name.
profile.headline: What you do
profile.headlineHint: One line — it appears under your name.
profile.skillsHint: This is how teams find you.
profile.skillsEmpty: No results. Press Enter to add your own skill.
profile.focusHint: People use this to decide whether to reach out.
profile.focusPlaceholder: I'm building something like… I'm looking for someone to…
profile.visibilityOn: Others can find you in search and in Discover.
profile.visibilityOff: Your profile is hidden — nobody will find you.
profile.errors.publicName: Name in Discover: {min}–{max} characters or empty.
profile.errors.headline: What you do: at most {max} characters.
